title: 第二十三章 三位同乡第二十四章 莲藕危
content_zh:
陈杰昌闻声转头，见到李立波后嗤笑一声：“怎么不能是我？你都能来，我不能来？”
“嘿，你找事是吧？”
李立波撸起袖子，作势要教训一下陈杰昌。
向长松挡在了两人中间，笑道：“两位的感情很好啊。”
“谁和他感情好？*2”
梁渠在边上挠挠头，陈杰昌，他对这人也有印象。
义兴市人不少，有上千口人，其中渔民家庭占一半，同龄人也就几十位，李立波是一位，陈杰昌也是一位，抬头不见低头见的，大家都互相认识。
梁渠十五六岁，李立波十七八岁，至于陈杰昌年纪就更大些，差不多十九二十。
相比于李立波有两个大哥，养出了些游手好闲的性子，陈杰昌只有个姐姐，本人则是出了名的捕鱼好手，每天收入在百文以上，几乎和现在的梁渠差不多。
陈杰昌可没有金手指，实打实的靠自己本事抓的。
向长松道：“以往也不是没有义兴市的人来过，但同时有三位还是比较少见的，既然你们都认识，那接下来的事情就交给梁师弟和李师弟了。”
梁渠点头：“好。”
“杰哥。”
“阿水。”
陈杰昌点点头，态度明显比对李立波的好一些，说起他来学武，还真有些梁渠的因素在内。
两人一同捕到宝鱼的那天，陈杰昌的风头完全被梁渠给盖过了，都是年轻人，心中自然不忿，觉得平白被抢了风头。
可交秋税那天，陈杰昌亲眼看到了梁渠的所作所为，不忿又变成了敬佩。
平心而论，换做是他，绝对是舍不得拿出来那一石米的，接着又听说梁渠去学了武......
陈杰昌卖了宝鱼本就不少钱，再加上先前攒的，交了秋税都有不少富余，便动了心思，同样想搏个出路。
片刻后，鲁少会回来，得知自己又多一位学生，并且同样来自义兴市后，眉头又一次皱下来，但很快又恢复平静。

陈杰昌察觉到不妙，接下来他的遭遇也印证了这点，若不是梁渠和李立波指出错误，他完全不知道自己做出来的桩功对没对。
来之前想到过渔民身份低微，自己可能会被歧视，没想到如此严重。
若非梁渠和李立波先前在胡奇的指导下基础打得牢固，能代替指导，估计一天都学不了几个好桩。
要不是听梁渠说有个胡奇武师能指望，陈杰昌都快沉不住气了。
梁渠劝慰道：“再忍一忍，等我学完鹤拳就好了，到时候我来教你。”
三拳法中有部分桩功是相同相似的，只有三分之一左右的部分差别较大，前面有过基础，学起来会很快。
昨天加今天一上午，梁渠已经学完虎拳，估计到明天就能学完鹤拳。
陈杰昌深吸一口气，压下烦躁：“麻烦阿水了。”
“小事，武馆就我们三位同乡，自然要互相帮扶。”
李立波撇撇嘴：“你怎么不说麻烦我？我刚才也教你了好吧？”
“你？呵。”
“？”
......
“你说那小子去学武了？”
庭院内，穿着白色锦衣的郑向绕着桃树团团转，凋零的落叶纷纷，显得他心绪浮杂。
content_en:
Chen Jiechang turned around when he heard the sound and sneered when he saw Li Libo: "Why can't it be me? You can come, but I can't come?"
"Hey, you're looking for trouble, right?"
Li Libo rolled up his sleeves, pretending to teach Chen Jiechang a lesson.
Xiang Changsong stood between the two of them and said with a smile: "The relationship between the two is very good."
"Who has a good relationship with him? *2"
Liang Qu scratched his head beside him, Chen Jiechang, he also had an impression of this person.
There are many people in Yixing City, with over a thousand people, half of whom are fishermen's families, and there are only a few dozen people of the same age. Li Libo is one, and Chen Jiechang is also one. They all know each other even if they look up and look down.
Liang Qu was fifteen or sixteen, Li Libo was seventeen or eighteen, and Chen Jiechang was older, almost nineteen or twenty.
Compared to Li Libo, who had two eldest brothers who had a somewhat idle temperament, Chen Jiechang only had an older sister, and he himself was a well-known fishing expert, with an income of more than a hundred yuan a day, almost the same as Liang Qu now.
Chen Jiechang didn't have a golden finger, he really relied on his own ability to catch it.
Xiang Changsong said: "It is not that no people from Yixing City have come here in the past, but it is relatively rare to have three of them at the same time. Since you all know each other, the next thing will be left to Junior Brother Liang and Junior Brother Li."
Liang Qu nodded: "Okay."
"Brother Jack."
"Ah Shui."
Chen Jiechang nodded, and his attitude was obviously better than that towards Li Libo. When it came to him learning martial arts, there was something about Liang Qu.
On the day they caught treasure fish together, Chen Jiechang was completely overshadowed by Liang Qu. They were both young people, so they were naturally unhappy and felt that they had been robbed of the limelight for nothing.
But on the day when the autumn taxes were paid, Chen Jiechang saw with his own eyes what Liang Qu had done, and his anger turned into admiration.
To be fair, he would definitely be reluctant to take out the stone rice. Then he heard that Liang Qu went to learn martial arts...
Chen Jiechang already had a lot of money from selling Baoyu, plus what he had saved previously, he had a lot of surplus after paying the autumn taxes, so he started thinking about finding a way out.
After a while, Mr. Lu came back. After learning that he had another student, who was also from Yixing City, his brows furrowed again, but he soon regained his composure.
Chen Jiechang sensed that something was wrong, and what happened next confirmed this. If Liang Qu and Li Libo hadn't pointed out the mistake, he would have no idea whether the tricks he performed were correct or not.
Before coming here, I thought that because of the low status of fishermen, I might be discriminated against, but I didn't expect it to be so serious.
If Liang Qu and Li Libo hadn't laid a solid foundation under Hu Qi's guidance before and could take the place of guidance, they probably wouldn't have learned a few good lessons in a day.
If he hadn't heard from Liang Qu that there was a Hu Qi martial artist he could count on, Chen Jiechang would have almost lost his temper.
Liang Qu consoled him: "Just bear with it a little longer and wait until I finish learning Crane Fist. Then I will teach you."
Some of the pile skills in the three boxing techniques are the same and similar, and only about one-third of the parts are significantly different. If you have the foundation in the past, you will learn it quickly.
Yesterday plus this morning, Liang Qu has finished learning Tiger Fist, and he is expected to finish learning Crane Fist by tomorrow.
Chen Jiechang took a deep breath and suppressed his irritation: "I'm sorry, Ah Shui."
"It's a small matter. There are only three of us in the martial arts school, so we naturally have to help each other."
Li Libo curled his lips: "Why didn't you tell me to trouble me? I taught you just now, okay?"
"You? Huh."
"?"
...
"You said that boy went to learn martial arts?"
In the courtyard, Zheng Xiang, dressed in white brocade clothes, walked around the peach tree. The fallen leaves were falling, making him appear to be in a confused state of mind.
